about_the_game:
Welcome to Noon Stone

Jump into quick, tactical adventures where every roll of the dice shapes your destiny. Explore procedurally generated maps, battle through fast-paced encounters, and chase endless victories in bite-sized roguelite runs.

Noon Stone is an exploration and survival game inspired by solo tabletop role-playing games. Your mission: find a lost crystal named Noon Stone, in a hostile world. Every day counts, dangers grow, and enemies become stronger. Will you make the right choices to survive and triumph before it's too late?

🧭 A playable demo will be available before the upcoming Steam Next Fest / stay tuned! 🧭

❤️ Wishlist now and prepare to roll your fate when the demo drops!❤️

Key Features

🎲 Dice-driven tactical battles

🗺️ Explore randomly generated maps and survive

🛡️ Build your character with gear, skills, and luck

⚡ Fast 5-15 minute runs

🔁 Endless replayability with evolving strategies

🧩 Simple to learn, challenging to master

📖 A black-and-white world with hand-drawn look

💯 Challenge yourself and beat your own score

How it plays

Roll your hero: Random class and stats

Explore: Choose your path across a hexagonal map

Fight: Battle enemies with dice rolls

Trade: Find settlements to sell loot and upgrade

Hunt clues: Search for the Noon Stone's location

Grow stronger: Gain XP and level up your skills

Survive: Outlast rising dangers and evolving enemies

Score: Beat your previous high score

A new adventure every time

No two runs are the same. Every map and enemy is randomly generated, making every session a fresh tactical challenge. Experiment, adapt, and see how far your luck — and your strategy — will take you.
